area: Austin, Texas, USA (South Congress, East Cesar Chavez, Barton Springs) - mock data
source: Synthetic mock data generated for workshop demos. Not real reviews of real businesses.
adaptations: All restaurants, addresses and reviews are fictional mock data. Any resemblance to real businesses is coincidental.
google_place_id is pending:mock:<slug>, so seed.py keeps these restaurants out of sync_targets. Do not send them to the Places API.
Each restaurant has a quality profile per criterion (food, service, price, ambience, cleanliness, wait), so market comparison and aspect analysis show visible differences.
google_rating is the mean of the review stars in this dump; user_rating_count is the review count in this dump.
reviews.text is NOT NULL. Star-only reviews are stored as empty text with text_missing=true, like the Alaska dump.
source_id / external_review_id are UUIDv5 values derived from dataset, restaurant slug and index, so re-runs upsert instead of duplicating.
author_uri is null: no real contributor profiles are referenced.
